Alaric is an inhabitant of the Refugee camp and essential for the Vampire quest line. You can find him inside a tent. He will tell you emphatically he does not believe the tales of vampires, so you have to watch him.

==Quests==
===Supply him with Blood===

Alaric is weak because of starvation. He asks you for a drop of {{Item|Blood}} or {{Item|Bucket of blood}}. After delivering he will reward you with {{Item|Sun cream for vampires}} as a reward. This can be shown to [[Horadric]] to make him believe you took care of the vampire and to end the vampire quest line.

He also points out to use the {{Item|Witchers eye}} to find the vampires that turned him into one. 

After his quest, supplying him with {{Item|Bucket of blood}} will get you a {{Item|Scroll of Teleportation}}. Or {{Money|25}} for every {{Item|Blood}}.
